[P2] Preserve non-blocking NOT_IMPLEMENTED outcomes

When a template declares the suite's sole requirement, `telemetry-1`, under `TestingMetadata.NotImplemented` without a matching handler, the runner exits successfully before processing that declaration or writing reports/history. This upload then fails the job, contradicting the documented non-blocking policy for missing SDK capabilities. Route zero-match runs through coverage and report generation so explicit declarations produce non-blocking `NOT_IMPLEMENTED` reports while undeclared gaps still fail. Add regression coverage for both cases.
